title: React and React Native Developer
description:
React and React Native Developer

*B2B E Commerce Job Description*

ARB Accessories Pvt. Ltd. | Full-time

**Experience:**

Minimum 3+ years of hands-on development experience in React and React Native within the B2B e-commerce domain.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced React and React Native Developer to build and maintain enterprise-level B2B e-commerce web and mobile applications.

The developer will work closely with our ERPNext/Frappe backend developers, Project Manager, designers and business teams to deliver reliable, secure and scalable customer-facing applications. The role requires strong API integration skills and a practical understanding of B2B buying, pricing, ordering and fulfilment workflows.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Develop and maintain responsive web applications using React and Android/iOS mobile applications using React Native.

· Build reusable components, shared application logic and a consistent design system across web and mobile.

· Implement product catalogues, search, filters, product variants, quantity-based pricing, MOQ/UOM, stock availability, cart and checkout.

· Develop B2B workflows covering quotations, customer-specific pricing, credit limits, payment terms, orders, invoices, shipment tracking and returns.

· Integrate frontend applications with ERPNext/Frappe through REST APIs.

· Work closely with Frappe backend developers to define API contracts, request/response structures, authentication, pagination, validation and error handling.

· Integrate payment gateways, logistics services, notifications, search engines and other third-party platforms.

· Implement secure login, session management and permission-aware interfaces, with authorization enforced by backend APIs.

· Manage application state, caching, loading states, retries and network failures to provide a reliable customer experience.

· Improve performance across catalogue pages, large product lists, images, search and mobile screens.

· Write maintainable code, participate in code reviews, and resolve defects through testing and debugging.

· Support UAT, production releases, app-store submissions and ongoing application improvements.

· Maintain technical documentation for components, integrations and application setup.
